Meet our beloved Turtle amigurumi — a round, squishy little friend with a textured shell and the softest, most huggable body. Each turtle is crocheted stitch by stitch using premium anti-pill yarn in earthy greens and warm creams. With safety eyes and a gentle embroidered smile, this piece is as comforting as it is adorable. A perfect gift for all ages.
